verdict.rationale: LangGraph's first-party docs and README point to LangSmith tracing as its observability UI. The README says it gives 'deep visibility' by tracing execution paths, capturing state transitions and providing runtime metrics, and the workflows docs say to 'trace and compare these workflow patterns with LangSmith' to see how data flows through each step. A community comment also notes the predeclared graph enables a full debugging UI even for partially executed runs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that every individual LLM call and tool invocation is captured as a span, detail on setup since tracing relies on the separate LangSmith service, and independent hands-on corroboration of tracing coverage.
